general.openAtLoginDesc: Runs in the menu bar only, so agents’ questions and failed tasks reach you right away.
general.openAtLoginDesc_win: Runs in the notification area only, so agents’ questions and failed tasks reach you right away.
general.loginItemsApproval: Also allow it in System Settings › Login Items.
general.loginItemsApproval_win: Also turn it on in Settings › Apps › Startup.
general.agentQuestionsDesc: Expire after 30 minutes if no one answers
general.menuBadge: Show a dot on the icon when something needs you

update.title: Updates
update.autoDownloadDesc: Once downloaded, they install when Aide quits or restarts

account.removeDeviceMessage: It is signed out at once: the server drops it and your machines refuse its connections; its own machine is removed too. It can log in again with the account and password.
account.signOutRemovedMessage: This computer was signed out of your Aide account. Leave, then log in again if you like.
account.signOutFirstMessage: This computer is still logged in to your account. Sign it out from another of your devices (Settings › Account & Devices), then leave here. Or change the password here, and sign it out from another device.
account.devicesNote: Every computer and phone that logged in with the account and password is here. Lost one? Sign it out here, or change the password.
account.machineOnlyNote: This computer is a machine of your account: it runs agents’ tasks and can’t see your other machines.

login.title: Account and Password
login.onDesc: A new computer, phone, machine or agent logs in with the server {{server}}, this account and the password: nothing to approve.
login.offDesc: Logging in is off: no new device, machine or agent can log in; those logged in stay.
login.convertTitle: An old password login to convert
login.convertDesc: This server was set up before accounts. Type the password you set then, and the server keeps the account itself from now on: your devices, machines and agents keep working.
login.changeNote: A new password has 8 characters or more, and signs out your other devices and every agent (not this computer, nor your machines).
login.offNote: No one can log in until you turn it on again here.
login.onNote: Anyone with the account and password can log in again.
login.convertNote: The password you set for the password login.
login.changed: Password changed; {{count}} devices and agents signed out
login.converted: Converted: the server keeps your account now
login.cost: The server keeps your account (only a hash of the password) and signs every credential for you: anyone who knows the password, or gets the server’s data, can log in as you and run tasks on your machines. Use a long password, and give the server HTTPS.

grants.note: Access controls which projects, machines, and coding agents an agent can use, and for how long.
grants.disconnectMessage: It will lose access immediately. Any running tasks will be interrupted, while task history is preserved. Reconnect it if you want to use it again.
grants.disconnectedOffline: Disconnected “{{name}}”; {{machines}} offline, will take effect once back online
grants.her: Her is no longer part of Aide · Disconnect to remove this grant
grants.execDesc: Lets it run shell commands directly on these machines, for operations. Every call, refused ones too, is in the Ops Log. Off unless you turn it on.
grants.allMachinesLater: All machines (including ones that join later)
grants.renameMessage: Shown here and on your other devices. Other agents only see the name.
grants.iconAutoHint: Matches its name or where it signs in (for example, a connection from cursor.com appears as Cursor).
grants.iconBad: Couldn’t read that image. Try a PNG or JPEG.

ops.none: No agent has run a command yet.
ops.unreachable: Not listed: {{machines}} can’t be reached now.
ops.note: The commands agents ran on your machines with Run commands (Access), and those refused. Each machine keeps its last 500; their output is kept nowhere.

machines.deviceNote: This machine is also your device “{{name}}”. To sign it out, go to <go>Account & Devices</go>.
machines.shareDesc: Aide runs them from the command line just as you do, without reading API keys or tokens. Turning this off stops active tasks here.
machines.renameMessage: Agents refer to projects as “machine/project”, so renaming updates how they address this machine. Use only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
machines.nameUnusable: This name has no letter or digit. Machine names use only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
machines.removeMessage: This machine will disconnect immediately and any running tasks will stop. It logs in again with the account and password to rejoin.
machines.offlineAgents: Machine is offline; agents will appear once it reconnects
machines.howToConnect: How to Connect DSH, Claude Desktop…

wake.title: Wake on New Messages
wake.note: Aide calls its routine to wake it when a task it started finishes or another agent writes to it. For another bot on this connection, ask that bot.
